main_text.p: um coërcebatur rabies, nec erat impune peccatum. Nunc autem sub religionis titulo, exercentur iniusta compendia, & honor nominis [Iesuitici] Christiani fraudem magis facit quàm patitur. Quodque pudet dicere ( sed necesse est vt saltem sic ad nostrum erubescamus dedecus ) publicè extendentes manus, pannis aurum tegimus: & contra omnium opinionem plenis sacculis morimur diuites, qui quasi pauperes viximus. Hieronymus, Tom.1. Epistola ad Rusticum monachum.

Nihil est grande, tristi & lurida facie, vel simulare, vel ostentare ieiunia: possessionum redditibus abundare, & vile iactare palliolum. Item. Si cupis esse, quod diceris monachus, id est solus, quid facis in urbibus, quæ utique non sunt solorum habitacula, sed multorum? Item. Quæ senseris aut semper aut crebrò de nummis loquentem, institorem potius habeto quàm monachum. Epist.ad Paulinum.

Postquam nobilium introierunt domos, & deceperūt mulierculas oneratas peccatis, semper discentes, & nunquam ad scientiam veritatis perueniẽntes, tristitiam simulant: & quasi longa ieiunia, furtiuis noctium cibis protrahunt. page.notes: The page number is printed in old form as "y04" and is read as 904. The running head is printed in small capitals. The bracketed word "[Iesuitici]" is printed in the text in italics and is kept as printed. The short stray mark after "Epist.ad Paulinum." and the marks at the foot of the page, together with the digitiser's stamp at lower right, are not printed text and are left out. The headings XXVIII and XXIX are bare numbers and are therefore written as paragraphs.
